batch.title: Organization, Artist, and Venue administration
batch.goal: Scope organization settings and Artist/Venue administration to authorized organizations and remove global discovery and unsafe writes.
exitCriteria: Search, CRUD, import, metrics, relationships, and deletion are tenant-scoped and server-authorized.
Org B, forged identifier, revoked user, direct API, and unsafe-delete tests pass.

findings.title: Artists API globally unscoped; POST upsert clobbers existing profiles by email; DELETE callable w/o UI
findings.solution: Scope by acting org; replace upsert; remove/guard delete
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: Venues admin API cross-org leak via venue_name joins; no org linkage; grid uses public search API
findings.solution: Structural FK to org/event; scope queries
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: CSV import sequential POSTs discarding error detail; metrics via unscoped tables
acceptanceCriteria: Polish/debt item resolved or explicitly accepted with rationale.

findings.title: /admin/request writes to nonexistent admin_requests via browser anon client
acceptanceCriteria: Polish/debt item resolved or explicitly accepted with rationale.

workflows.title: Artist Administration and Relationship Management

producer.outcome: Searches, invites, imports, edits, or removes an organization Artist relationship.

recipients.outcome: Retains the global profile while organization membership changes safely.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Organization Admins may access only their roster relationships; global profiles cannot be clobbered or hard-deleted through roster operations.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Roster state changes without cross-organization enumeration or global-profile loss.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

workflows.title: Venue Administration and Relationship Management

producer.outcome: Creates or maintains a structurally linked Venue relationship.

recipients.outcome: Sees only authorized venues and correctly scoped event metrics.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Venue reads and writes require an organization or event relationship; names are never authorization joins.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: The venue list and counts contain only structurally authorized records.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.

recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

workflows.title: Organization Settings, Membership, and Administration

producer.outcome: Updates an organization setting or membership through a governed server command.

recipients.outcome: Sees the authorized setting or membership result.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Settings and memberships are organization-scoped, audited server writes; browser clients cannot perform privileged direct updates.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: The setting or membership change is visible only inside the target organization.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.title: Two-organization RLS matrix passes
launchGates.acceptance: Positive and cross-organization negative cases pass for every exposed domain.

launchGates.title: Multi-organization switching and revocation pass
launchGates.acceptance: Switch, stale-tab, revocation, and cache invalidation behave consistently in UI, API, and database.
